rows.name: Home First Finance Company India Limited

coverage: Whole company · housing finance and property-backed lending
incomeDefinition: Interest on loans and other financial assets, fees, gains from transferring loan balances and other income, before borrowing and operating costs.
definition: The lender’s reported profit after funding costs, expected loan losses, operating expenses and tax.
location: PDF page 6, audited statement of financial results, full years ended 31 March 2026 and 2025.
notes: The source uses ₹ million. Total income includes ₹1,664.02 crore of interest income. Finance costs were ₹792.32 crore and the charge for expected losses on financial assets was ₹56.88 crore. The filing provides whole company profit rather than a split by loan type.
insight: Interest supplies most of the income. Compare it with interest on borrowed money and the cost of losses on loans to see what the company keeps.
